title: Agentic AI Systems and Financial Stability, From Model Risk to Systemic Risk
abstract: arXiv:2610.08806v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial stability rests on the premise that distress is largely idiosyncratic and therefore diversifiable: when one institution errs, the rest of the system absorbs the shock. That premise fails when many decision-makers depend on the same infrastructure. Agentic AI systems, which take consequential actions rather than only emitting predictions, are becoming such a substrate, and the binding concern shifts from the model risk of a single deployment to the systemic risk of the population. We develop this account in six mathematical settings. Chapter 1 recasts the PD/LGD/EAD decomposition of expected loss as an expected-harm identity and introduces a set-valued containment-risk measure; under a lever-assignment axiom that review cannot intercept an irreversible action, no non-preventive control satisfies a coherent tail constraint. Chapter 2 lifts this to a fleet sharing a foundation model: the shared model is a non-diversifiable common

translated_title: 智能体AI系统与金融稳定：从模型风险到系统性风险
translated_abstract: 金融稳定建立在这样一个前提之上：即困境在很大程度上是个体性的，因此是可分散的——当一家机构犯错时，系统的其他部分会吸收冲击。当众多决策者依赖同一基础设施时，这一前提便会失效。智能体AI系统采取具有重大后果的行动，而不仅仅是输出预测，正在成为这样一种基础设施，因此核心关切从单一部署的模型风险转变为整个群体层面的系统性风险。我们在六个数学框架中阐述这一论点。第一章将预期损失的PD/LGD/EAD分解重构为预期伤害恒等式，并引入一个集值的遏制风险度量；在杠杆分配公理（即事后审查无法拦截不可逆行动）下，任何非预防性控制都无法满足一致的尾部约束。第二章将此提升到共享同一基础模型的智能体集群层面：共享模型构成了一个不可分散的共同……
tldr: 本文提出当众多机构依赖同一智能体AI基础设施时，风险将从可分散的单点模型风险演变为不可分散的系统性风险，并通过六个数学框架证明在事后审查无法拦截不可逆行动的情况下，必须采取预防性控制才能满足尾部风险约束。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that when many institutions depend on the same agentic AI infrastructure, risk shifts from diversifiable single-model risk to non-diversifiable systemic risk, and proves across six mathematical settings that no non-preventive control can satisfy coherent tail constraints when review cannot intercept irreversible actions.
